measurementNotes: Browser measurements taken after all owned Blender jobs completed.
Frame intervals include browser scheduling and host activity; render CPU timing does not measure asynchronous GPU completion.
Vehicle rendering fixtures were preserved: no increased triangles, material batches, image count, decoded texture pixels or download bytes.
Added world machinery can increase world draw/triangle counts; report records current measurements rather than asserting uniform speedups.
Preset contents were being edited independently during this pass; only the fixed 64-vehicle fixture is intended for direct before/after comparison.
